package.name: varietas_demo
package.description:
Two RViz demonstrations, answering the two different questions.
sweep.launch.py is the forward one: the arm is posed by robot_state_publisher from the decimals in the URDF, and a marker is placed at the tool pose computed by varietas from the exactly recovered chain. The two coincide at every configuration, which is what the recording in the README shows, and the node measures the agreement and logs it, because it is 1e-12 m and no image resolves that.
branches.launch.py is the inverse one: a target is moved through the workspace and every configuration the generated solver returns for it is drawn at once, which is what an iterative solver cannot produce. The solver is emitted from the URDF during this build, by the path urdf_codegen --decouple takes, so a regression in the emitter stops this package building. Beside the solved arm stands the KUKA LBR iiwa, posed but not solved, carrying the refusal parametric_position_ik returns for it.
Demonstration only; nothing in the pipeline depends on it.
